name: X-Gaussian
definition: A radiative Gaussian splatting method for efficient X-ray novel view synthesis (NVS) and sparse-view CT reconstruction, replacing RGB Gaussian point clouds with a radiative model and using Differentiable Radiative Rasterization (DRR).
summary: X-Gaussian is a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for X-ray imaging that replaces RGB color with view-independent radiation intensity to enable efficient novel view synthesis and sparse-view CT reconstruction.
